comparison.objective: Candidate sets mechanical travel; PR-996 calibrates a colorimeter and measures a sample.
comparison.physical_skill: Countertorque and tool regrasping differ from cuvette orientation, insertion, lid operation, button use, and sample handling.

comparison.reason: Their physical procedures and observable outcomes do not overlap meaningfully.
